goal: Design an evidence-complete Invoke lifecycle that exposes and closes every discoverable scope, decision, ownership, dependency, material-admission, validation, and closeout blocker before execution. Once those gates pass, one approved outer work-pack route should execute the finite SWU frontier without predictable returns to generic Refresh, while empirical runtime failures remain honest typed residue.
context: Current Invoke runs can be locally valid yet require repeated planning refreshes, route projection syncs, materialization refreshes, and Task Session retries before product work starts. The Body War atlas sequence is the current concrete witness, and prior OEW and Invoke reviews show the same late-discovery and ownership pattern. Research must preserve fail-closed safety and the single-SWU Task Session boundary while designing a more complete upfront artifact and one-shot outer execution route; it may recommend capability changes but cannot implement them.
anti_bias_global: upfront evidence completeness versus the smallest executable handoff without safety or ownership regression

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 runs empirical repository forensics while agent 1 runs historical and modern external precedent analysis on the methodology and source-corpus axes; a local-history bias in agent 0 would be exposed by agent 1's proven workflow patterns, while cargo-cult precedent in agent 1 would be exposed by agent 0's exact owner-hop receipts.

Agent 0 reconstructs actual blocker discovery and artifact churn while agent 2 derives a formal requirements and state-machine protocol on the methodology axis; a symptom-only bias in agent 0 would be exposed by agent 2's invariant model, while an idealized protocol bias in agent 2 would be exposed by agent 0's counterexamples.

Agent 1 compares external build, workflow, and plan-apply precedents while agent 2 derives repository-native ownership and admission contracts on the source-corpus and temporal-prior axes; a borrowed-pattern bias in agent 1 would be exposed by agent 2's local non-collapse constraints, while local path dependence in agent 2 would be exposed by agent 1's mature precedents.

agents.angle: empirical repository forensics over Invoke, Refresh, readiness, Task Session, and closeout owner hops
agents.initial_prompt: Work read-only. Reconstruct at least the current Body War atlas sequence and the strongest prior OEW or DS-SFOL sequence from current source artifacts and observability. Read the canonical Invoke and Task Session contracts, both Invoke workflow reflections, all Body War Define/Design/Plan and three Refresh reports, the blocked chain, the ready SWU-001 handoff, and relevant central telemetry. Produce: a timestamped owner-hop graph; one row per blocker with first-knowable stage, first-detected stage, responsible owner, artifacts rewritten, whether safety was protected, whether product capability advanced, and the earliest deterministic gate that could have caught it; counts for refreshes, plan rewrites, Task Session bounces, baseline invalidations, and no-progress owner returns; and a strict classification of discoverable preflight blockers versus empirical runtime failures. Inventory leads: OEW runtime rebuild lessons, Body War plan review, and current Invoke/Distill review. Re-verify every load-bearing statement from exact source paths and selectors. Do not edit files.

agents.angle: historical-lineage and modern primary-source precedent analysis for complete planning, durable execution, and semantic invalidation
agents.initial_prompt: Work read-only and use primary external sources. Compare mature mechanisms that separate discovery, planning, admission, execution, and replay: compiler analysis before code generation, build-system analysis/execution graphs, saved plan/apply workflows, durable workflow engines, requirements traceability, and transactional or saga-style orchestration. For each precedent, provide immutable source identity and selector, the exact behavior it owns, what it detects before execution, how it treats unknown runtime failures, plan/version invalidation, resume semantics, and what should or should not transfer into Arcanum. Identify whether the desired pattern is already owned, build-from-owned, or precedent-clean; do not call an empty Inventory lookup precedent-clean. Return a comparison matrix and 3-5 transferable invariants, not a generic best-practices list.

agents.angle: formal requirements and protocol architecture for an upfront-complete objective artifact and one-shot outer work-pack execution
agents.initial_prompt: Work read-only. Inspect canonical Invoke Define/Design/Plan/Refresh/Handoff/Validate, Task Session mutation admission, Task Session Until Blocker, Goal, Context Builder, Decision Gate, Interrogation, and Work Pack Readiness Audit owners. Derive a target protocol that preserves their non-collapse: objective discovery; question and decision closure; owner/dependency closure; execution-admission compilation; immutable plan epoch; semantic invalidation; one approved outer frontier run; one-SWU inner sessions; terminal closeout. Specify a normalized objective-execution manifest with fields, states, producers, consumers, invariants, typed blocker classes, readiness verdicts, and exact transition ownership. Compare at least four candidates: harden Invoke Plan, add a pre-Plan closure stage, add a separate execution-admission compiler/materializer, or keep generic Refresh repair. Include migration boundaries and positive/single-fault negative fixtures. The user wants the most complete artifact possible, but distinguish knowable blockers from empirical runtime failures.

Reconcile the three explorer returns into an exact-binding target architecture. Produce: (1) plain-language root cause; (2) current and target lifecycle diagrams; (3) blocker first-knowable versus first-detected matrix; (4) candidate verdicts for hardening Plan, adding closure, adding an admission compiler/materializer, and retaining generic Refresh; (5) one normalized objective-execution manifest with exact fields and owner transitions; (6) a plan-epoch and semantic invalidation protocol; (7) a one-shot outer work-pack algorithm that still launches one bounded Task Session per SWU; (8) capability ownership and migration map; (9) deterministic positive and negative replay fixtures, including the Body War sequence; and (10) progress metrics and loop detection. Every load-bearing claim must cite an explorer return and exact local selector or primary-source selector. Preserve disagreements, unknown runtime residue, and public/private boundaries. Do not edit capability or product files.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 attacks precedent and existing ownership while agent 1 attacks non-vacuity on the attack-vector axis; a novelty bias in agent 0 would be exposed by agent 1's Body War replay, while a local-demo bias in agent 1 would be exposed by agent 0's owner and primary-source analysis.

Agent 0 tests whether candidate mechanisms are already owned while agent 2 tests definitional collapse on the attack-vector axis; a build-from-owned label that duplicates a local capability would be exposed by agent 2, while a collapse claim that ignores a distinct external invariant would be exposed by agent 0.

Agent 1 requires a concrete no-bounce execution witness while agent 2 attacks lifecycle and vocabulary collapse on the attack-vector axis; a mechanically useful but semantically duplicated candidate accepted by agent 1 would be exposed by agent 2, while a tidy vocabulary with no executable consequence accepted by agent 2 would be exposed by agent 1.

agents.angle: precedent gate over existing Arcanum owners and primary external workflow mechanisms
agents.initial_prompt: Attack only the precedent gate. Verify every proposed lifecycle mechanism against current Arcanum owners and primary external sources. Label each candidate already-deployed, build-from-owned, or precedent-clean; precedent never issues KILL. Identify any proposal that invents a new capability where Decision Gate, Interrogation, Implementation Readiness, Work Pack Readiness Audit, Context Builder, Goal, Task Session, or an established external pattern already owns the behavior. Replace secondary or unsourced claims with exact owner references.

agents.angle: non-vacuity gate requiring a counterfactual Body War replay and measurable reduction in predictable owner returns
agents.initial_prompt: Attack only non-vacuity. Replay the exact Body War atlas sequence against every surviving target protocol. Require the proposed upfront artifact and gates either to detect the missing SWU-001 material/closeout contract before Task Session routing or to justify why that is impossible. Require a measurable acceptance target: one approved outer work-pack run, zero predictable returns to generic Refresh, no route-only projection invalidation of execution baselines, and preserved fail-closed behavior for real drift. KILL any candidate that merely renames Refresh, moves the same blocker without changing first-detection time, cannot provide positive and single-fault negative fixtures, or promises unknowable runtime certainty.

agents.angle: definitional-soundness gate against collapsing planning, readiness, materialization, execution, and closeout
agents.initial_prompt: Attack only definitional soundness. Test the synthesis for duplicated capabilities, overloaded terms, and authority collapse. Invoke must not become product executor; Task Session must not become question discovery; Work Pack Readiness Audit must not become planning authority; a generated continuation view must not become an execution baseline owner; one-shot outer execution must not erase the single-SWU inner boundary; and a complete artifact must not claim future empirical certainty. KILL tautological or re-skinned candidates and name the exact existing owner or merge target.

After exact-binding evidence closure is ready, write findings.md only. Lead with a plain-language answer explaining why plans and Refreshes block in the middle and what can realistically be moved upfront. Include current versus target architecture, normalized objective-execution manifest, blocker/question/decision closure contract, plan epoch and invalidation rules, material-owner decision, one-shot outer work-pack route, preserved single-SWU Task Sessions, capability owner map, migration sequence, stop-doing list, progress metrics, exact Body War replay, positive/negative fixtures, unresolved decisions, and the required five-column verdict matrix. Cite every load-bearing local or external claim. Recommend a bounded Spellcraft route but do not author another Invoke plan or implement capability changes.

Audit findings.md only against the dispatch goal and exact-binding evidence contract. APPROVE only if it distinguishes discoverable pre-execution blockers from empirical runtime failures; explains the current owner loop with exact evidence; front-loads decisions, dependencies, material admission, validation, and closeout without collapsing capability owners; preserves fail-closed digests and one-SWU Task Sessions; demonstrates the Body War counterfactual; provides machine-checkable fixtures and measurable no-bounce criteria; cites primary precedents; and names one bounded migration route. Otherwise return one bounded writer revision. Approval is research acceptance only, not implementation or publication authority.
